title: MV DreamX Extended Battle Status Core: applying animation flashes to status faces?

posts.author: LittleMisterFrosty
posts.body:
This is a pretty niche question, but I'm using DreamX's Extended Battle Status Core for the front-view battle system. Animations for skills that target actors show above the HUD as intended, but their faces do not flash as specified by the Target function in the animation builder. For animations that consist only of flashes, this can be a bit disorienting visually. Is there any way to modify the plugin, or some other plugin entirely that I can add, to make the status faces flash like sprites do when targeted by skills with these animations?
Here's a screenshot to clarify what I mean:
I am not using battler sprites in this project.
I've played around with plugins like Waynee95's Custom Face Image Eval script but that unfortunately didn't quite do the trick. I found
another
thread from a few years ago with a similar request but it never received an answer.

posts.author: Kenen
posts.body:
Doing this requires targeting the face for the animation’s flash effect, which would require extensions to the status plugin.
If the plugin is drawing the faces directly to the window (e.g. via blt) rather than as independent sprites then this would require an even more extensive rework of the plugin, as the faces need to be drawn as independent sprites in order to be directly compatible with the game’s default flashing routines used by animations.
